
Download from https://www.un4seen.com/bass.html and put into `AE-Bin/external/android-clang/BASS`.

Folder structure:
```
BASS
 include
    bass.h
    bassenc.h
    bassenc_mp3.h
    bassenc_ogg.h
    bassflac.h
    bassmix.h
    basswebm.h
 lib
   arm64-v8a
     libbass.so
     libbassenc.so
     libbassenc_mp3.so
     libbassenc_ogg.so
     libbassflac.so
     libbassmix.so
     libbasswebm.so
   armeabi-v7a
     libbass.so
     libbassenc.so
     libbassenc_mp3.so
     libbassenc_ogg.so
     libbassflac.so
     libbassmix.so
     libbasswebm.so
 license
   ...
```
